QuestInfo.name: [Eluna] Maynard's Lesson: Elemental, my Dear Hero
QuestInfo.0: It's time for your next prospecting lesson!\r\nTalk to #p9400461#.
QuestInfo.1: The #o9402197# is a giant boss blocking which blocks the way to Eluna's Badlands!\r\nThe #o9402197# is very dangerous, but it possesses an extremely valuable #t2436828# crystal. Other heroes are sure to challenge the creature.\r\nJoin forces with them, and defeat the #o9402197#!
QuestInfo.2: There is one Elunite Crystal whose value stands above all others, #t2436828#. The surest way to obtain is was to hunt the #o9402197#. There was no way you could have defeated it on your own, but thankfully you had the help of other prospectors.

default.0: The #o9402197# can be found on the way to the Badlands. You're right to fear it, but a great award awaits those who manage to defeat it.
